fact: Article 708 of Loi n 019/AN/23/9eme L portant Code Numerique, promulgated 6 July 2025, requires administrations to exchange all information strictly necessary to process a request, and Articles 709-710 provide for a general interoperability and security reference framework to be set by decree and attested by each administration for its teleservices.
title: Loi n 019/AN/23/9eme L portant Code Numerique (annexe, JO special n 04)
